response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of solid software engineering experience and valuable entrepreneurial background as a founder, he lacks the deep, recognized AI expertise and strategic leadership required for a Director-level AI Strategy role. His exposure to AI appears to be very recent and tactical, rather than the visionary, platform-defining experience expected to advise enterprise customers and shape the future state of cloud AI products.
strengths: Over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and backend systems.
Valuable entrepreneurial experience as the founder of an open-source Geo-Data platform (GISCollective).
Strong track record of technical community engagement through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks the required recognized expertise and deep strategic background in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Current seniority (Senior/Staff) and scope of work do not align with the expectations of a Director-level strategic IC role.
Limited evidence of advising strategic enterprise customers or shaping high-level cloud and AI product strategies.
